scope: Partial M6 management reads required by unchanged React startup: M3U accounts/nested profiles/filters/server groups and EPG sources/data. Does not establish native import/scheduler or full backend parity.

ordering_correction.cause: Aggregate/cron joins reordered outer account/source rows and nested groups relative to stable original select_related/prefetch output. Values were identical by ID.
ordering_correction.fix: Retain original interval/crontab join projection, preserve source base row ordinals before aggregate joins, and scope through-row prefetch to selected parent IDs. No response sorting or test normalization.

fixture_policy: Disposable loopback-published Compose only; optional external IP lookup disabled in original source model.
Metadata bulk ORM operations bypass external import signals; example.invalid URLs and disabled PeriodicTask only.
Active/inactive/default expiration dates, UTC microseconds versus second tooltips, differing filter order, legacy JSON/profile-ID coercion and exact integer/fraction/integral-float/large JSON types.
EPG has_channels follows raw channel EPG mapping, not override-only mapping; passwords follow source role visibility.
normalization: None for provider/source response bodies. Exact canonical JSON values/types/list ordering compare; credentials and raw bodies never recorded.
remaining_gates: Account/profile/filter/server/source mutations, refresh/upload/account-info actions and their validation/effects remain unsupported.
Native import/scheduling, program/grid/current-program reads, Schedules Direct, provider credential pools and the broader recorded M5/M6 migration gaps remain incomplete.
